description: Land Acquisition - Sinhapura, Kolonnawa D/S Division, Colombo District - Kiriwaththuduwa, Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Akarahediya, Laggala, Pallegama D/S Division, Matale District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains multiple orders directing acquiring officers to take possession of specific land parcels with detailed descriptions of the properties, including their locations, boundaries, and extents. While a government minister is named (Harin Fernando), the core content focuses exclusively on land/property matters rather than government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities, making it a Land Gazette (Type 4).
